meta.name: The Town
meta.description:
A group of cash-strapped friends find their morals and relationships tested when they stumble upon a stolen fortune in their hometown.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Money troubles plague Efe and Selim after the death of their mother, but an accidental discovery appears to be the answer to all of their problems.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Efe urges Selim to leave town, but memories of their brother's death give him pause. Ahmet runs into a familiar face more often than he would like.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When Ahmet starts spending recklessly, an observant Yıldırım takes it upon himself to track down his money... by any means necessary.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Injuries are incurred when Ahmet becomes impulsive with a gun. A trauma-ridden Efe reaches out to a wary old friend to set his conscience at ease.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Efe and Ahmet find their consciences tested when Yıldırım stumbles into a life and death situation. Müfit becomes entangled in his own web of trouble.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Feelings of guilt and shame overwhelm Ahmet as he lies about Müfit's whereabouts, but the friends are now too deep in secrecy to escape their fate.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Believing Selim to be on the run, Efe is released from prison to track him down. But when he discovers his brother's fate, all cards are off the table.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Efe takes on the responsibility of the crimes with a recorded confession, but Begüm is unable to take a back seat and let him face his undoing alone.
